items.hook: Kappa1 Ceti is a yellow-hued variable star in the equatorial constellation of Cetus.
items.body: Its name is a Bayer designation that is Latinized from κ1 Ceti, and abbreviated Kappa1 Cet or κ1 Cet. The world is stranger than it lets on.
